title: Pin CARGO_TARGET_DIR in both installers
action: Set CARGO_TARGET_DIR to the checkout-local packages/bee-rs/target on the cargo build invocation in scripts/install.sh and scripts/install.ps1 so the binary lands where the scripts already look, even when the host overrides the cargo target dir. Run bee dev regen inside this cell (release manifest hashes the installers).
verify: bash -n scripts/install.sh; bee dev release-manifest --check; reproduce the failing install with CARGO_TARGET_DIR set
acceptance: install.sh completes on a host with CARGO_TARGET_DIR set; ps1 mirrors the same pin; release-manifest --check green

trace.outcome: CARGO_TARGET_DIR pinned on both installer build lines; release manifest re-hashed; failing install reproduced green

report.outcome: installers build into the exact path their binary check reads on every host; ps1 restores the callers CARGO_TARGET_DIR after the build
report.tests: bash -n scripts/install.sh; bee dev release-manifest --check; CARGO_TARGET_DIR=~/.cache/cargo-target bash scripts/install.sh -y — green (bash -n ok; 277 files match manifest; installer completed: bee installed) — shell-script change, the proof is the exact failing invocation now completing
